entities.name: Integrity checking of NAS signalling messages
entities.description: Procedure for integrity checking of NAS signalling messages in the UE.

relations.description: Integrity checking procedure requires that secure exchange of NAS messages has been established.
Integrity checking procedure is guarded by successful integrity check condition.
IDENTITY REQUEST (IMSI) message may be accepted without integrity protection.
ATTACH REJECT (non-EMM cause #25) message may be accepted without integrity protection.
DETACH ACCEPT (non switch off) message may be accepted without integrity protection.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT (non-EMM cause #25) message may be accepted without integrity protection.
SERVICE REJECT (non-EMM cause #25) message may be accepted without integrity protection.
All ESM messages are integrity protected and require successful integrity check.
Failure of integrity check establishes the property to discard the message.
Receipt of non-integrity protected message when secure exchange is established establishes the property to discard the message.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND message that fails integrity check triggers specific discard behavior as specified in clause 5.4.3.5.
